) b ON ( a.plan_date = b.plan_date AND a.mix_area = b.mix_area AND a.glue = b.glue AND a.del_flag = '0' ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE

select count(*) from T_GLUE_COLLECT_PLAN t
t.del_flag='0' and t.plan_date=str_to_date(#{planDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and t.mix_area=#{mixArea} and (instr(t.MACHINE_CODE,',')>0 or t.MACHINE_CODE is null)

SELECT #{planDate} AS SCHEDULE_DATE, ENTRUST_MIX_AREA, /*委托密炼区*/ ENTRUSTED_MIX_AREA, /*被委托密炼区*/ a.GLUE, /*胶料*/ p.PRODUCE_QTY AS SEND_QTY, /*发送数量*/ now() AS SEND_TIME, /*发送时间*/ p.id as SCHEDULE_ID, '0' AS RECEIVE_STATUS, /*状态：未接收*/ '0' AS SOURCE, /*来源：分解胶料需求量*/ '0' AS IS_AUTO, /*根据跨区设置表生产的发送记录*/ p.machine_code as decompose_machine_code /*分解的机台如果是空，说明跨区后的生产量需要重新计算*/ FROM T_GLUE_SPAN_SETTING a INNER JOIN T_GLUE_DECOMPOSE_PLAN p ON a.ENTRUST_MIX_AREA = p.MIX_AREA AND a.GLUE = p.GLUE WHERE a.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND p.DEL_FLAG = '0' AND a.ENTRUST_MIX_AREA = #{mixArea} AND p.plan_date = #{planDate} AND (a.ENTRUSTED_MIX_AREA, a.GLUE) NOT IN ( /*过滤掉自动分解后已经被接收的胶料*/ SELECT ENTRUSTED_MIX_AREA,GLUE FROM T_GLUE_SPAN_RECEIVE t where schedule_date = #{planDate} and ENTRUST_MIX_AREA = #{mixArea} and SOURCE ='0' /*数据来源：分解胶料*/ and IS_AUTO = '0' /*根据跨区设置表生产的发送记录*/ and RECEIVE_STATUS = '1' /*已接受*/ )
mapper.update: UPDATE T_GLUE_SPAN_RECEIVE SET DEL_FLAG ='1' where schedule_date = #{planDate} and ENTRUST_MIX_AREA = #{mixArea} and SOURCE ='0' /*数据来源：分解胶料*/ and IS_AUTO ='0' /*根据跨区设置表生产的发送记录*/ and RECEIVE_STATUS = '0' /*未接收*/

UPDATE T_GLUE_SPAN_SEND SET DEL_FLAG ='1' where schedule_date = #{planDate} and ENTRUST_MIX_AREA = #{mixArea} and SOURCE ='0' /*数据来源：分解胶料*/ and IS_AUTO ='0' /*根据跨区设置表生产的发送记录*/ and RECEIVE_STATUS = '0' /*未接收*/

insert into T_GLUE_SPAN_RECEIVE p using ( SELECT MIX_AREA, GLUE, (case when instr(MACHINE_CODE,',') = 0 then MACHINE_CODE else substr(MACHINE_CODE, 1,instr(MACHINE_CODE,',')-1) end) as machine_code /*如果有多个机台，则只拿第一个机台*/ FROM ( SELECT f.MIX_AREA,f.GLUE, REGEXP_REPLACE(LISTAGG(f.MACHINE_CODE, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY f.MACHINE_ORDER), '([^,]+)(,\1)*(,|$)','\1\3') as MACHINE_CODE /*机台根据机台顺序升序排序*/ FROM T_FORMULA_MACHINE f INNER JOIN T_MIX_MACHINE m1 ON f.mix_area=m1.mix_area and f.machine_code = m1.machine_code and m1.status = '0' and m1.del_flag = '0' WHERE f.DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY f.MIX_AREA, f.GLUE) ) m on (p.glue = m.glue and p.entrusted_mix_area = m.mix_area and p.del_flag = '0' and p.send_id in #{sendId} and p.schedule_date = #{planDate}) when matched then update set p.MACHINE_CODE = m.MACHINE_CODE

insert into T_GLUE_SPAN_RECEIVE p using (SELECT d.MIX_AREA, d.GLUE, REGEXP_REPLACE(LISTAGG(d.MACHINE_CODE, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY d.MACHINE_CODE), '([^,]+)(,\1)+','\1') AS MACHINE_CODE /*密炼机台*/ FROM T_MACHINE_GLUE_DECOMPOSE d INNER JOIN T_MIX_MACHINE m on d.machine_code = m.machine_code and m.DEL_FLAG = '0' and m.STATUS='0' WHERE d.DEL_FLAG = '0' GROUP BY d.MIX_AREA, d.GLUE) m on (p.glue = m.glue and p.entrusted_mix_area = m.mix_area and p.del_flag = '0' and p.send_id in #{sendId} and p.schedule_date = #{planDate}) when matched then update set p.MACHINE_CODE = m.MACHINE_CODE
